scope: Illustrative fixed-rate purchase loans and annual rental planning. No live rate, insurance, tax or rental-income defaults. Not underwriting or a lender disclosure.

sources.name: HUD current FHA mortgage insurance structure
sources.verified: 1.75% purchase upfront MIP and annual-premium bands by original base amount, LTV and term. The $726,200 premium band is not an FHA county loan limit.

sources.name: HUD Mortgagee Letter 2023-05
sources.verified: Annual MIP rate table and 11-year versus full-term duration. Current HUD FAQ cross-checked this session; special programs excluded.

sources.name: HUD monthly mortgage insurance calculation
sources.verified: Original scheduled average beginning balances, financed upfront factor removed, annual and monthly rounding. Historical worked example used only as a mathematical test, not a current premium rate.

sources.name: VA purchase funding fees and closing costs
sources.verified: First use, subsequent use, down-payment bands and lender-confirmed exemptions. Financing versus cash payment modeled separately. No monthly VA mortgage insurance.

sources.name: CFPB PMI removal
sources.verified: Requested cancellation at 80% differs from automatic scheduled 78% termination and midpoint rule. Extra payments do not advance the automatic date. Current payments assumed.

sources.name: CFPB compare loan estimates
sources.verified: Separate interest and costs from principal paid, compare rate, fees, credits and closing cash over a common ownership period.

sources.name: CFPB Closing Disclosure
sources.verified: Prepaids, initial escrow, credits, deposits and closing cash are distinct budget components.

sources.name: Florida DBPR vacation rental guide
sources.verified: Official state licensing resource. Calculator makes no property-specific rental-permission finding.

sources.name: Gulf Shores rental licensing
sources.verified: Local licensing, zoning review and lodging-tax guidance. Users must check the actual jurisdiction and property.

sources.name: CFPB mortgage servicing and extra principal
sources.verified: Reviewed during the component port. Extra principal may reduce interest; partial payments can be held until a full periodic payment is available. Confirm the servicer's application rules.

limitations: Price assumed to equal the original property value used for LTV. Appraisal gaps, county loan limits, jumbo eligibility, credit and lender overlays require review.
Standard new fixed-rate purchase loans only; no ARM, interest-only, balloon, refinance, buydown, recast or specialized FHA programs.
Conventional borrower-paid PMI annual rate stays constant until scheduled automatic termination; earlier servicer-approved removal is not presumed.
Taxes, insurance and association costs stay at user-entered dollar amounts throughout the comparison.
Loan comparison treats annualized property costs as expenses; prepaids and initial escrow appear in initial cash, not again as extra period expenses.
Rentals use 365 days and annual-average income. Personal-use time reduces availability. No appreciation, sale proceeds or income-tax benefits are forecast.
Rental debt coverage uses NOI / annual debt service and is not a lender DSCR qualification calculation. Capital replacement reserves are excluded from NOI and deducted from cash flow.

Biweekly and weekly accelerated options use the military calculator's monthly-equivalent approximation: 13 monthly payments annually. Custom weekly extras also use a monthly equivalent; exact posting dates and daily accrual are not modeled.
